title: Asset Migrated
description: This event occurs when an asset is migrated.

asset_id.title: Asset ID
asset_id.description: Unique asset identifier defined by client. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It can be used to make redemptions and cancellations.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Cetip code of registrator of asset. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It needs to be in every API call. An organization can have multiple issuer IDs.

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: External identifier for operation. Optional field provided by customer in asset migration operation.

ticket_symbol.title: Ticket Symbol
ticket_symbol.description: External ticket symbol. Field provided by external service.

operation_code.title: Operation Code
operation_code.description: External operation code. Field provided by external service.

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: Creation date of asset migrate operation on Pismo platform

customer_name.title: Customer name
customer_name.description: Name of asset quota owner. Can be a company or an individual.

customer_document_number.title: Customer document number
customer_document_number.description: Number of asset quota owner's legal document

type.title: Entity type
type.description: Legal nature of asset quota owner

migrated_units.title: migrated quota units
migrated_units.description: Number of quota units migrate by asset quota owner

deposit_number.title: Deposit number of the asset quota
deposit_number.description: Optional attribute provided by client when registering asset quota on Pismo platform

operation_code.title: Operation code
operation_code.description: Optional attribute generated when registering asset quota on Pismo platform

ticket_symbol.title: Ticket symbol
ticket_symbol.description: Optional attribute generated when registering asset quota on Pismo platform
